messages:
maya: Handoff — I'm primary until 06:00 UTC. Quick summary: ongoing INC3102 (kv-cache/evictions) affecting p99 tail latency for text-gen and some 503 spikes for embeddings. Current mitigations: scaled cache nodes from 2 -> 4, enabled fallback routing for low-priority traffic to dedicated pool, and disabled experimental cache-ttl optimizer. Customer impact: acme and novus tenants seeing ~5-8% elevated errors. Status page: set to "investigating". Runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evictions and dashboard https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv-evict. Primary actions for next shift: monitor evictions, watch canary, coordinate with CS if errors worsen, and escalate to infra if evictions > 300/s or error rate >10%.

incident-bot: Pager INC3102 triggered at 2026-03-14T22:42:11Z — metric: kv_evictions_rate > 200 for 3m. Severity: P2. Linked alert: alert/kv_eviction_surge.

jon: I am listed as secondary but heads-up: I have a calendar block 04:00-05:00 UTC (meeting). I can be on-call via phone but can't deep-dive. There's a gap 04:00-05:00 unless someone covers.

liam: I can cover 04:00-05:30 UTC if needed. Will add myself to the rotation for that window. Taking responsibility for canary checks and traces while jon is in the meeting.

maya: @liam thanks — I'm assigning you as secondary for 04:00-05:30 in the handoff. Jon — please mark your oncall status as limited for that hour. Note: the canary nodes (canary-kv-03..05) are where we validate the scale change.

maya: Mitigations in progress (do not revert unless told):
- scaled kv-cache deployment: replicas 2 -> 4 (rolling)
- enabled fallback routing: low-priority requests routed to dedicated-pool-us-west
- disabled cache-ttl-optimizer feature flag (ff/cache-ttl-opt)

maya: Quick commands we used (copy/paste from runbook):
```
# check eviction spike
curl -s "https://api.metrics.redwood/kv/evictions?from=-15m" | jq .rate
# scale (k8s)
kubectl -n inference scale deployment kv-cache --replicas=4
# toggle FF
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://ff.redwood.internal/toggle -d '{"key":"ff/cache-ttl-opt","state":"off"}'
```

sre-bot: Auto-action: Canary deploy of scaled cache initiated (canary-ids: canary-03..canary-05). Will auto-roll back on error threshold > 5% in canary for 10m.

maya: Logs snippet showing eviction errors (last 5m):
```
2026-03-14T22:41:23Z WARN kv-cache evict key=usr:cache:12345 reason=memory_pressure score=0.87
2026-03-14T22:41:47Z ERROR request handler service=text-gen id=abc123 status=503 reason=cache_miss_and_eviction
2026-03-14T22:43:02Z WARN kv-cache evict key=emb:vec:98765 reason=shard_pressure score=0.92
```

maya: Customer comms: CS notified for acme & novus. They opened high-touch tickets; CS rep @sam will loop in customer success. I left a note in the acme ticket that we expect stabilization in ~15-30m if canary is healthy.

jon: I'll ping Sam and stand by for escalations. If evictions jump > 300/s I'll trigger infra escalation and we'll consider increasing mem quota on the cache nodes.

liam: I'll keep an eye on traces and tail latencies. Plan: check canary health at :10, :20, :30 relative to the hour. If canary error > 3% for two consecutive checks, revert scaling and open infra bridge.

maya: Coverage gap summary: Jon limited 04:00-05:00 UTC (phone available), Liam covering 04:00-05:30, I'm primary until 06:00. After 06:00, oncall rotates to next engineer (per rota). If nobody else jumps in, liam will hand off back to the normal secondary at 05:30.

maya: Important runbook links again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evictions and quick playbook snippet in #eng-oncall-pinned. Also pastebook for rollback: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollback-kv-scale.

liam: noted and ack. I'll post canary checks results here at :10 and :30.

jon: ack. I'll update my Slack status to "limited oncall 04:00-05:00 UTC" and leave my phone reachable.

sre-bot: Note: Incident INC3102 annotated with mitigation steps and assigned temporary secondary (liam). Timeline entry created.

maya: Leaving this thread for the overnight crew — add any observations here. If anyone else wants to take primary for the 05:30-06:00 window DM me. :wave:

liam: 22:50 check — canary metrics: error_rate=1.2%, evictions_rate=95/s, tail_p99 down 12% vs baseline. Looks stable so far.

jon: 22:52 — pinged Sam at CS, acme acknowledged and will monitor. They asked for ETA; I told them ~15-30m pending canary.

maya: thanks. I'm switching my status to "away - handing off" and will follow up on any escalations. Leaving notes in the runbook and the incident page.

liam: taking over monitoring, will post updates. ack.
